```{r}
## ======================================================================
## ONE-FILE SCRIPT (DISCOUNTED CASH FLOW / NPV, CONSTANT 2025 DOLLARS)
## - Equity (levered) cash flow
## - PV is 100% debt financed (no PV equity outflow in Year 0)
## - Crop basis paid in Year 0 (equity outflow)
## - Policy scenarios: MACRS / NOL / ITC / ITC sale / Bonus100
## - Tornado sensitivity includes discount rate
## ======================================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(ggplot2)
  library(scales); library(purrr); library(stringr); library(tibble)
})

## ---- 0) GLOBALS -------------------------------------------------------
years <- 25
total_acres <- 10

## Discount rate (REAL because CF is constant 2025$)
discount_rate <- 0.03

## PV sizing & costs (AC basis)
system_kw_ac <- 818
capex_per_kw <- 1678

## PV economics
P_elec               <- 0.07
solar_om_cost_per_kw <- 23.60
salvage_rate <- 0.10
## 5-year MACRS (half-year convention)
macrs_pv <- c(0.20,0.32,0.192,0.1152,0.1152,0.0576)

## Taxes
federal_tax_rate  <- 0.21
state_tax_rate    <- 0.0884
combined_tax_rate <- federal_tax_rate + state_tax_rate * (1 - federal_tax_rate)

## Land & AV layout
alpha <- 0.10
land_rent_per_acre <- 0
annual_land_rent   <- land_rent_per_acre * total_acres

## Loan & inverter
loan_term                 <- 15
interest_rate             <- 0.05
inverter_replacement_year <- 15
## Inverter replacement cost ($/kW-AC)
inverter_replacement_cost_per_kw <- 70.87

## ITC sale settings (if policy sells ITC in Year 1)
itc_sale_price <- 0.90

## Site kWh (Year 1)
G_solar_base <- c(
  El_Centro=1987900.40, Mecca=2017947.10, Bakersfield=1821452.40,
  Modesto=1751131.00, Fresno=1751000.00, Chico=1762015.40,
  Oxnard=1770692.40, Salinas=1747830.00, Davis=1783881.50
)
site_for_plots <- "Davis"

## Ag machinery MACRS (7-yr)
macrs_ag <- c(0.1429, 0.2449, 0.1749, 0.1249, 0.0893, 0.0892, 0.0893, 0.0446)
```

```{r}
## ---- 2) ROTATIONS -----------------------------------------------------
make_rotation <- function(summer_vec, winter_vec = c("Fallow","Fallow"), n_years = years) {
  tibble(
    Year   = 1:n_years,
    Summer = rep(summer_vec, length.out = n_years),
    Winter = rep(winter_vec, length.out = n_years)
  ) %>%
    mutate(Summer = str_trim(Summer), Winter = str_trim(Winter))
}

rot_TGC <- make_rotation(c("Tomato","Garbanzo","Corn"))
rot_BGC <- make_rotation(c("Bell_Peppers","Garbanzo","Corn"))

lam_base_TGC <- -0.30
lam_base_BGC <-  0.03
```


```{r}
## ---- 3) NOL helper ----------------------------------------------------
apply_nol_80 <- function(taxable_income_pre_nol, nol_cf_start) {
  TI_pre  <- taxable_income_pre_nol
  nol_beg <- nol_cf_start

  if (TI_pre > 0) {
    max_offset <- 0.80 * TI_pre
    nol_used   <- min(nol_beg, max_offset)
    TI_post    <- TI_pre - nol_used
    nol_end    <- nol_beg - nol_used
  } else {
    nol_used <- 0
    TI_post  <- TI_pre
    nol_end  <- nol_beg + (-TI_pre)
  }

  list(TI_post = TI_post, NOL_used = nol_used, NOL_end = nol_end)
}
```


```{r}
## ---- 4) Policy table --------------------------------------------------
policy_tbl <- tibble(
  Policy = c("MACRS",
             "MACRS+NOL",
             "MACRS+ITC",
             "MACRS+NOL+ITC",
             "MACRS+NOL+ITC sold Y1",
             "Bonus 100% (Y1 only, NO MACRS)",
             "Bonus 100%+NOL"),
  itc_rate      = c(0.00, 0.00, 0.30, 0.30, 0.30,0.00, 0.00),
  use_nol       = c(FALSE, TRUE, FALSE, TRUE, TRUE, FALSE,TRUE),
  sell_itc      = c(FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, TRUE, FALSE,FALSE),
  pv_dep_method = c("macrs","macrs","macrs","macrs","macrs","bonus100","bonus100")
)
```


```{r}
## ---- 5) AV engine (equity CF, constant 2025$) -------------------------
av_table_policy <- function(lam_override,
                            rotation,
                            policy = "MACRS+NOL",
                            site   = "Davis",
                            ## pass scenario values so sensitivity is clean
                            P_elec_in               = P_elec,
                            capex_per_kw_in         = capex_per_kw,
                            solar_om_cost_per_kw_in = solar_om_cost_per_kw,
                            interest_rate_in        = interest_rate,
                            salvage_rate_in         = salvage_rate,
                            alpha_in                = alpha,
                            water_saving_in         = water_saving,
                            discount_rate_in        = discount_rate) {

  stopifnot(site %in% names(G_solar_base))
  stopifnot(policy %in% policy_tbl$Policy)

  pol <- policy_tbl %>% filter(Policy == policy) %>% slice(1)

  itc_rate_local <- pol$itc_rate[[1]]
  use_nol_local  <- pol$use_nol[[1]]
  sell_itc_local <- pol$sell_itc[[1]]
  dep_method     <- pol$pv_dep_method[[1]]

  area_av  <- total_acres * (1 - alpha_in)
  base_kwh <- as.numeric(G_solar_base[[site]])

  ## PV cost + inverter replacement cost (cash)
pv_cost_local <- system_kw_ac * capex_per_kw_in

# NEW: fixed inverter replacement cost based on $/kW-AC
inverter_replacement_cost_local <- inverter_replacement_cost_per_kw * system_kw_ac

inverter_salvage_rate_local <- 0.10
  ## ITC (credit amount)
  itc_amt <- itc_rate_local * pv_cost_local

  ## Depreciation basis reduction if ITC claimed/sold
  basis <- pv_cost_local * (1 - itc_rate_local/2)

  ## PV depreciation streams
  bonus_dep_y1 <- 0
  macrs_sched  <- rep(0, length(macrs_pv))

  if (dep_method == "macrs") {
    macrs_sched <- basis * macrs_pv
  } else if (dep_method == "bonus100") {
    bonus_dep_y1 <- basis
    macrs_sched  <- rep(0, length(macrs_pv))
  } else {
    stop("Unknown pv_dep_method in policy_tbl.")
  }

  ## Inverter depreciation stream (5-yr MACRS starting replacement year)
  inv_dep_stream <- rep(0, years)
  if (inverter_replacement_year <= years) {
    s <- inverter_replacement_year
    for (i in seq_along(macrs_pv)) {
      yr <- s + i - 1
      if (yr <= years) inv_dep_stream[yr] <- inv_dep_stream[yr] + inverter_replacement_cost_local * macrs_pv[i]
    }
  }

  ## Crop basis (Year 0 outflow)
  s1 <- rotation$Summer[1]; w1 <- rotation$Winter[1]
  cap_s1 <- if (s1!="Fallow") capital_investment_per_acre[[s1]] else 0
  cap_w1 <- if (w1!="Fallow") capital_investment_per_acre[[w1]] else 0
  ag_basis_av <- (cap_s1 + cap_w1) * area_av

  ## 100% debt financing of PV
  loan_payment_local <- (pv_cost_local * interest_rate_in) / (1 - (1 + interest_rate_in)^(-loan_term))
  loan_balance <- pv_cost_local

  rows <- vector("list", years + 1)

  ## Year 0 equity CF:
  ## - PV CapEx is financed by debt => no PV equity outflow here
  ## - Crop basis is paid in cash => equity outflow
  rows[[1]] <- tibble(
    Year=0, Net_CF=-ag_basis_av, PV_CF=-ag_basis_av,
    Tax=0, Taxable_Income=0, NOL_End=0, ITC_Rem=itc_amt
  )

  nol_cf <- 0
  itc_cf <- itc_amt

  lam_of <- function(crop) if (crop=="Fallow") 0 else lam_override
  ws_of  <- function(crop) if (crop=="Fallow") 0 else water_saving_in[[crop]]

  for (y in 1:years) {

    s <- rotation$Summer[y]; w <- rotation$Winter[y]

    ## Revenues
    yld_s <- if (s!="Fallow") yield[[s]] else 0
    prc_s <- if (s!="Fallow") price[[s]] else 0
    yld_w <- if (w!="Fallow") yield[[w]] else 0
    prc_w <- if (w!="Fallow") price[[w]] else 0

    revenue_crops <- (yld_s*prc_s*area_av*(1+lam_of(s))) + (yld_w*prc_w*area_av*(1+lam_of(w)))
    revenue_solar <- base_kwh * (1 - 0.005*(y-1)) * P_elec_in

    revenue_pv_salv  <- if (y==years) salvage_rate_in * pv_cost_local else 0

    salv_s1 <- if (s1!="Fallow") salvage_value_per_acre[[s1]] else 0
    salv_w1 <- if (w1!="Fallow") salvage_value_per_acre[[w1]] else 0
    revenue_ag_salv  <- if (y==years) (salv_s1 + salv_w1) * area_av else 0

    revenue_inv_salv <- if (y==years && years >= inverter_replacement_year)
      inverter_salvage_rate_local * inverter_replacement_cost_local else 0

    ## Costs
    cost_crops <- (if (s!="Fallow") total_cost[[s]] * area_av else 0) +
                  (if (w!="Fallow") total_cost[[w]] * area_av else 0)

    cost_irrig <- (if (s!="Fallow") irrig_cost[[s]] * area_av * (1 - ws_of(s)) else 0) +
                  (if (w!="Fallow") irrig_cost[[w]] * area_av * (1 - ws_of(w)) else 0)

    cost_solar_om <- solar_om_cost_per_kw_in * system_kw_ac
    cost_inverter_cash <- if (y==inverter_replacement_year) inverter_replacement_cost_local else 0

    ## Loan schedule
    loan_interest  <- if (y<=loan_term) loan_balance * interest_rate_in else 0
    loan_payment_y <- if (y<=loan_term) loan_payment_local else 0
    loan_principal <- if (y<=loan_term) loan_payment_y - loan_interest else 0
    loan_balance   <- if (y<=loan_term) max(0, loan_balance - loan_principal) else 0

    ## Depreciation
    dep_solar_macrs    <- if (y <= length(macrs_pv)) macrs_sched[y] else 0
    dep_solar_bonus    <- if (y == 1) bonus_dep_y1 else 0
    dep_inverter_macrs <- inv_dep_stream[y]
    dep_machinery      <- if (y <= length(macrs_ag)) ag_basis_av * macrs_ag[y] else 0

    ## Taxable income (pre-credits, pre-NOL)
    taxable_income_pre <- (revenue_crops + revenue_solar + revenue_pv_salv + revenue_ag_salv + revenue_inv_salv) -
      cost_crops - cost_irrig - cost_solar_om - annual_land_rent -
      loan_interest - dep_solar_macrs - dep_solar_bonus - dep_inverter_macrs - dep_machinery

    ## NOL
    if (isTRUE(use_nol_local)) {
      nol_res <- apply_nol_80(taxable_income_pre, nol_cf)
      taxable_income_post <- nol_res$TI_post
      nol_cf <- nol_res$NOL_end
    } else {
      taxable_income_post <- taxable_income_pre
      nol_cf <- 0
    }

       ## ---- Tax calculation: separate state and federal -------------------
    ## State tax is computed first
    state_tax_pre <- max(0, taxable_income_post * state_tax_rate)

    ## Federal taxable base after deducting state tax (matches your old combined-rate logic)
    federal_taxable_base <- taxable_income_post - state_tax_pre
    federal_tax_pre <- max(0, federal_taxable_base * federal_tax_rate)

    ## ITC handling
    itc_cash_sale <- 0
    itc_used <- 0

    if (isTRUE(sell_itc_local)) {
      ## Sell entire ITC in year 1 as cash; do not offset taxes directly
      if (y == 1 && itc_cf > 0) {
        itc_cash_sale <- itc_sale_price * itc_cf
        itc_cf <- 0
      }
      federal_tax_paid <- federal_tax_pre
      state_tax_paid   <- state_tax_pre

    } else {
      ## ITC offsets FEDERAL tax only
      if (itc_cf > 0 && federal_tax_pre > 0) {
        itc_used <- min(itc_cf, federal_tax_pre)
        itc_cf   <- itc_cf - itc_used
      }

      federal_tax_paid <- max(0, federal_tax_pre - itc_used)
      state_tax_paid   <- state_tax_pre
    }

    taxes_paid <- federal_tax_paid + state_tax_paid

    ## Equity net cash flow (after tax, after debt service)
    net_cf <- (revenue_crops + revenue_solar + revenue_pv_salv + revenue_ag_salv + revenue_inv_salv + itc_cash_sale) -
      cost_crops - cost_irrig - cost_solar_om - annual_land_rent -
      loan_payment_y - cost_inverter_cash - taxes_paid

    ## Present value
    pv_cf <- net_cf / (1 + discount_rate_in)^y

    rows[[y+1]] <- tibble(
      Year=y, Net_CF=net_cf, PV_CF=pv_cf,
      Tax=taxes_paid, Taxable_Income=taxable_income_post,
      NOL_End=nol_cf, ITC_Rem=itc_cf
    )
  }

  bind_rows(rows) %>% mutate(Cum_NPV = cumsum(PV_CF))
}
```


```{r}
## ---- 6) AgOnly engine (policy-driven, constant 2025$) -----------------
policy_tbl_ag <- policy_tbl %>%
  transmute(
    Policy,
    itc_rate      = 0.00,
    sell_itc      = FALSE,
    use_nol       = use_nol,
    ag_dep_method = pv_dep_method
  )

agonly_table <- function(rotation, policy_name = "MACRS+NOL",
                         discount_rate_in = discount_rate) {

  pol <- policy_tbl_ag %>% filter(Policy == policy_name)
  if (nrow(pol) != 1) stop("AgOnly: policy_name not found (or duplicated).")

  use_nol    <- pol$use_nol[[1]]
  dep_method <- pol$ag_dep_method[[1]]
  tax_rate   <- combined_tax_rate

  yld  <- function(c) if (c=="Fallow") 0 else unname(yield[c])
  prc  <- function(c) if (c=="Fallow") 0 else unname(price[c])
  oc   <- function(c) if (c=="Fallow") 0 else unname(total_cost[c])
  ir   <- function(c) if (c=="Fallow") 0 else unname(irrig_cost[c])
  salv <- function(c) if (c=="Fallow") 0 else unname(salvage_value_per_acre[c])
  cap  <- function(c) if (c=="Fallow") 0 else unname(capital_investment_per_acre[c])

  s1 <- rotation$Summer[1]; w1 <- rotation$Winter[1]
  ag_basis_total <- (cap(s1) + cap(w1)) * total_acres
  ag_salv_total  <- (salv(s1) + salv(w1)) * total_acres

  nol_balance <- 0
  rows <- vector("list", years + 1)

  rows[[1]] <- tibble(
    Year=0, Net_CF=-ag_basis_total, PV_CF=-ag_basis_total,
    Tax=0, Taxable_Income=0, NOL_End=nol_balance
  )

  for (y in 1:years) {
    s <- rotation$Summer[y]; w <- rotation$Winter[y]

    revenue_crops <- yld(s)*prc(s)*total_acres + yld(w)*prc(w)*total_acres
    revenue_salv  <- if (y==years) ag_salv_total else 0

    cost_crops     <- oc(s)*total_acres + oc(w)*total_acres
    cost_irrig_tot <- ir(s)*total_acres + ir(w)*total_acres

    dep_mach <- 0
    if (dep_method == "bonus100") {
      dep_mach <- if (y == 1) ag_basis_total else 0
    } else if (dep_method == "macrs") {
      dep_mach <- if (y <= length(macrs_ag)) ag_basis_total * macrs_ag[y] else 0
    } else {
      stop("AgOnly: Unknown depreciation method.")
    }

    taxable_income_pre <- (revenue_crops + revenue_salv) - cost_crops - cost_irrig_tot - dep_mach

    if (isTRUE(use_nol)) {
      nol_res <- apply_nol_80(taxable_income_pre, nol_balance)
      taxable_income_post <- nol_res$TI_post
      nol_balance <- nol_res$NOL_end
    } else {
      taxable_income_post <- taxable_income_pre
      nol_balance <- 0
    }

    taxes_paid <- max(0, taxable_income_post * tax_rate)

    net_cf <- (revenue_crops + revenue_salv) - cost_crops - cost_irrig_tot - taxes_paid
    pv_cf  <- net_cf / (1 + discount_rate_in)^y

    rows[[y+1]] <- tibble(
      Year=y, Net_CF=net_cf, PV_CF=pv_cf,
      Tax=taxes_paid, Taxable_Income=taxable_income_post, NOL_End=nol_balance
    )
  }

  bind_rows(rows) %>% mutate(Cum_NPV = cumsum(PV_CF))
}
```

```{r}
## ---- 8) Override runner (no globals mutated) --------------------------
av_total_with_overrides <- function(rotation_tbl, lam_value, policy, overrides = list()) {

  P_elec_l               <- P_elec
  capex_per_kw_l         <- capex_per_kw
  solar_om_cost_per_kw_l <- solar_om_cost_per_kw
  interest_rate_l        <- interest_rate
  salvage_rate_l         <- salvage_rate
  alpha_l                <- alpha
  discount_rate_l        <- discount_rate
  water_saving_l         <- water_saving

  for (nm in names(overrides)) {
    if (nm == "water_saving_pct") {
      ws_val <- overrides[[nm]]
      ws_new <- setNames(rep(ws_val, length(water_saving_l)), names(water_saving_l))
      water_saving_l <- pmin(pmax(ws_new, 0), 0.90)
    } else if (nm == "P_elec")               P_elec_l               <- overrides[[nm]]
    else if (nm == "capex_per_kw")           capex_per_kw_l         <- overrides[[nm]]
    else if (nm == "solar_om_cost_per_kw")   solar_om_cost_per_kw_l <- overrides[[nm]]
    else if (nm == "interest_rate")          interest_rate_l        <- overrides[[nm]]
    else if (nm == "salvage_rate")           salvage_rate_l         <- overrides[[nm]]
    else if (nm == "alpha")                  alpha_l                <- overrides[[nm]]
    else if (nm == "discount_rate")          discount_rate_l        <- overrides[[nm]]
  }

  av_table_policy(
    lam_override               = lam_value,
    rotation                   = rotation_tbl,
    policy                     = policy,
    site                       = site_for_plots,
    P_elec_in                  = P_elec_l,
    capex_per_kw_in            = capex_per_kw_l,
    solar_om_cost_per_kw_in    = solar_om_cost_per_kw_l,
    interest_rate_in           = interest_rate_l,
    salvage_rate_in            = salvage_rate_l,
    alpha_in                   = alpha_l,
    water_saving_in            = water_saving_l,
    discount_rate_in           = discount_rate_l
  ) %>%
    summarise(v = last(Cum_NPV)) %>% pull(v)
}
```

```{r,fig.width=16, fig.height= 9.1}
## ---- 10) Tornado runner ----------------------------------------------
do_one_rotation_abs <- function(rot_name, rot_tbl, lam_baseline,
                                base_policy = "MACRS+NOL") {

  base_val <- av_total_with_overrides(rot_tbl, lam_value = lam_baseline,
                                      policy = base_policy, overrides = list())

  out_num <- purrr::pmap_dfr(sens_spec_num, function(Param, key, low, high) {

    if (key == "lambda") {
      lo <- av_total_with_overrides(rot_tbl, lam_value = low,  policy = base_policy, overrides = list())
      hi <- av_total_with_overrides(rot_tbl, lam_value = high, policy = base_policy, overrides = list())

    } else if (key == "water_saving_pct") {
      lo <- av_total_with_overrides(rot_tbl, lam_value = lam_baseline, policy = base_policy,
                                    overrides = list(water_saving_pct = low))
      hi <- av_total_with_overrides(rot_tbl, lam_value = lam_baseline, policy = base_policy,
                                    overrides = list(water_saving_pct = high))

    } else {
      lo <- av_total_with_overrides(rot_tbl, lam_value = lam_baseline, policy = base_policy,
                                    overrides = setNames(list(low), key))
      hi <- av_total_with_overrides(rot_tbl, lam_value = lam_baseline, policy = base_policy,
                                    overrides = setNames(list(high), key))
    }

    tibble(Rotation = rot_name, Param, Policy = base_policy, Baseline = base_val,
           Min = pmin(lo, hi), Max = pmax(lo, hi))
  })

  ## categorical: policy
  pol_vals <- policy_tbl$Policy
  pol_outcomes <- map_dbl(pol_vals, ~av_total_with_overrides(rot_tbl, lam_value = lam_baseline, policy = .x))
  out_pol <- tibble(
    Rotation  = rot_name,
    Param     = "Tax policy scenario",
    Policy    = base_policy,
    Baseline  = base_val,
    Min       = min(pol_outcomes, na.rm = TRUE),
    Max       = max(pol_outcomes, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

  ## categorical: site
  site_vals <- names(G_solar_base)
  site_outcomes <- map_dbl(site_vals, ~{
    av_table_policy(
      lam_override = lam_baseline,
      rotation     = rot_tbl,
      policy       = base_policy,
      site         = .x
    ) %>% summarise(v = last(Cum_NPV)) %>% pull(v)
  })

  out_site <- tibble(
    Rotation  = rot_name,
    Param     = "Location (site)",
    Policy    = base_policy,
    Baseline  = base_val,
    Min       = min(site_outcomes, na.rm = TRUE),
    Max       = max(site_outcomes, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

  bind_rows(out_num, out_pol, out_site)
}

base_policy_use <- "MACRS+NOL"

res_abs <- bind_rows(
  do_one_rotation_abs("Tomato–Garbanzo–Corn",     rot_TGC, lam_baseline = lam_base_TGC, base_policy = base_policy_use),
  do_one_rotation_abs("BellPepper–Garbanzo–Corn", rot_BGC, lam_baseline = lam_base_BGC, base_policy = base_policy_use)
) %>%
  group_by(Rotation) %>%
  mutate(Impact = abs(Max - Min)) %>%
  arrange(desc(Impact), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  ungroup()

## Reference lines: AgOnly + AV baseline
av_base_npv <- res_abs %>%
  group_by(Rotation) %>%
  summarise(AV_Base_NPV = first(Baseline), .groups="drop")

ref_lines <- agonly_cf %>%
  inner_join(av_base_npv, by="Rotation") %>%
  pivot_longer(c(AgOnly_NPV, AV_Base_NPV), names_to="Type", values_to="x") %>%
  mutate(Type = recode(Type,
                       AgOnly_NPV="AgOnly (reference)",
                       AV_Base_NPV="AV baseline"))

## ---- Plot: tornado heat-bar
abbr_map <- c(
  "Electricity price ($/kWh)" = "Elec price",
  "PV CapEx ($/kW-AC)"        = "PV CapEx",
  "Solar O&M ($/kW-yr)"       = "Solar O&M",
  "Yield change λ"            = "Yield λ",
  "Loan interest rate"        = "Loan rate",
  "PV salvage rate"           = "PV salvage",
  "Land-loss α"               = "Land-loss α",
  "Water-saving factor"       = "Water saving",
  "Discount rate"             = "Discount rate",
  "Tax policy scenario"       = "Policy",
  "Location (site)"           = "Location"
)

## ---- helper: build label text with low–high ranges --------------------
fmt_money_small <- function(x) scales::dollar(x, accuracy = 0.01)
fmt_money_int   <- function(x) scales::dollar(x, accuracy = 1)
fmt_pct         <- function(x) scales::percent(x, accuracy = 0.1)

range_tbl <- sens_spec_num %>%
  mutate(
    Param_short = recode(Param, !!!abbr_map),

    range_label = case_when(
      key == "P_elec"               ~ paste0(" (", fmt_money_small(low), " to ", fmt_money_small(high), "/kWh)"),
      key == "capex_per_kw"         ~ paste0(" (", fmt_money_int(low), " to ", fmt_money_int(high), "/kW)"),
      key == "solar_om_cost_per_kw" ~ paste0(" (", fmt_money_int(low), " to ", fmt_money_int(high), "/kW-yr)"),
      key == "lambda"               ~ paste0(" (", fmt_pct(low), " to ", fmt_pct(high), ")"),
      key == "interest_rate"        ~ paste0(" (", fmt_pct(low), " to ", fmt_pct(high), ")"),
      key == "discount_rate"        ~ paste0(" (", fmt_pct(low), " to ", fmt_pct(high), ")"),
      key == "salvage_rate"         ~ paste0(" (", fmt_pct(low), " to ", fmt_pct(high), ")"),
      key == "alpha"                ~ paste0(" (", fmt_pct(low), " to ", fmt_pct(high), ")"),
      key == "water_saving_pct"     ~ paste0(" (", fmt_pct(low), " to ", fmt_pct(high), ")"),
      TRUE ~ ""
    ),

    LegendLab = paste0(Param_short, range_label)
  ) %>%
  select(Param_short, LegendLab)

## Add the categorical rows too (no numeric range)
range_tbl <- bind_rows(
  range_tbl,
  tibble(Param_short = "Policy",   LegendLab = "Policy (all scenarios)"),
  tibble(Param_short = "Location", LegendLab = "Location (all sites)")
)
###
fmt_money <- function(v) ifelse(abs(v)>=1e6, paste0("$", round(v/1e6,2), "M"),
                                paste0("$", round(v/1e3,0), "k"))
x_breaks <- c(-1e6, -5e5, 0, 5e5, 1e6)

# ---- Prepare plot df in the SAME order as your good figure ------------
res_plot <- res_abs %>%
  group_by(Rotation) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(Max - Min)), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    Param_short = recode(Param, !!!abbr_map),
    Param_short = factor(Param_short, levels = unique(Param_short))
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Heat tiles from Min -> Max
heat_df <- res_plot %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(x_seq = list(seq(Min, Max, length.out = 220))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(Rotation, Param_short, x_seq) %>%
  unnest(x_seq) %>%
  rename(x = x_seq)

lims <- res_plot %>%
  group_by(Rotation) %>%
  summarise(mx = max(abs(c(Min, Max, Baseline)), na.rm = TRUE), .groups="drop") %>%
  left_join(ref_lines %>% group_by(Rotation) %>% summarise(mx_ref = max(abs(x)), .groups="drop"),
            by="Rotation") %>%
  mutate(mx_all = pmax(mx, mx_ref, na.rm=TRUE),
         xmin = -mx_all * 1.06, xmax = mx_all * 1.06)

heat_df  <- left_join(heat_df,  lims, by="Rotation")
res_plot <- left_join(res_plot, lims, by="Rotation")

top_row <- levels(res_plot$Param_short)[1]
ref_labels_top <- ref_lines %>%
  group_by(Rotation, Type) %>%
  summarise(x=first(x), .groups="drop") %>%
  mutate(
    Param_short = top_row,
    label = if_else(Type=="AgOnly (reference)",
                    paste0("AgOnly: ", dollar(x)),
                    paste0("AV base: ", dollar(x))),
    y_nudge = if_else(Type=="AgOnly (reference)", -0.45, +0.45)
  )

legend_tbl <- tibble(
  Param_short = c("Elec price","PV CapEx","Solar O&M","Yield λ","Loan rate","PV salvage",
                 "Land-loss α","Water saving","Discount rate","Policy","Location"),
  LegendLab   = c("Electricity price",
                 "PV CapEx",
                 "Solar O&M",
                 "Yield change (λ)",
                 "Loan interest rate",
                 "PV salvage rate",
                 "Land-loss (α)",
                 "Water-saving factor",
                 "Discount rate",
                 "Tax policy scenario",
                 "Solar irradiance site")
)

first_rot <- levels(factor(res_plot$Rotation))[1]
labels_once <- res_plot %>%
  mutate(Rotation=factor(Rotation, levels=unique(Rotation))) %>%
  filter(Rotation==first_rot) %>%
  distinct(Rotation, Param_short) %>%
  left_join(range_tbl, by="Param_short") %>%     # <-- THIS is the key change
  left_join(lims, by="Rotation") %>%
  mutate(
    x_lab = xmin - 0.06*(xmax-xmin),
    label = if_else(is.na(LegendLab), as.character(Param_short), LegendLab)
  )
p_heat <- ggplot() +
  geom_blank(data = heat_df, aes(x = xmin, y = Param_short)) +
  geom_blank(data = heat_df, aes(x = xmax, y = Param_short)) +
  geom_rect(
  data  = heat_df,
  aes(x = x, y = Param_short, fill = x),
  height = 0.75, width = diff(range(x_breaks))/420
) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype="dashed", color="grey40", linewidth=0.6) +
  geom_vline(
    data = ref_lines,
    aes(xintercept = x, linetype = Type),
    color="black", linewidth=0.9, show.legend=TRUE
  ) +
  geom_label(
    data = ref_labels_top,
    aes(x = x, y = Param_short, label = label),
    size=3.1, label.size=0.25, fill="white", color="black",
    vjust=-0.1, nudge_y = ref_labels_top$y_nudge
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ Rotation, scales="free_x") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    name="Cumulative NPV ($)",
    low="#E31A1C", mid="#FFD92F", high="#1A9850",
    midpoint=0, labels=dollar_format(accuracy=1e5)
  ) +
  scale_linetype_manual(
    name=NULL,
    values=c("AgOnly (reference)"="solid", "AV baseline"="dotted")
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks=x_breaks, labels=fmt_money,
    expand=expansion(mult=c(0.06,0.08))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Sensitivity of 25-year AV Net Present Value (NPV)",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Base policy = ", base_policy_use,
      " | Site = ", site_for_plots,
      " | discount rate = ", percent(discount_rate, accuracy = 0.1),
      " | δ = 8% | λ = +3% (Bell pepper), -30% (Tomato) | α = 10%\n",
      "Bars show the 25-year NPV range; lines indicate AgOnly (solid) and AV baseline (dotted)."
    ),
    x = "25-Year Net Present Value (NPV, constant 2025 $)",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size=13) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color="grey92"),
    axis.text.y        = element_blank(),
    strip.text         = element_text(face="bold", size=11),
    legend.position    = "right",

    legend.text        = element_text(size=9),
    panel.spacing.y    = unit(1.2,"lines"),
    plot.margin        = margin(t=10,r=20,b=10,l=160)
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(clip="off") +

    aes(x = x_lab, y = Param_short, label = label),
    hjust=1, vjust=0.5, size=3.5, color="grey15",

  )

print(p_heat)
```

```{r}
# ---- 13) YEAR-BY-YEAR CASH FLOW TABLES (AV + AgOnly) ------------------

# For pretty HTML tables
if (!requireNamespace("kableExtra", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("kableExtra")
library(kableExtra)

# For Excel export
if (!requireNamespace("openxlsx", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("openxlsx")
library(openxlsx)

fix_html_pipe <- function(x) gsub("&#124;", "|", x, fixed = TRUE)

make_cashflow_table <- function(df, scenario_name, discount_rate_in = discount_rate) {

  df2 <- df %>%
    mutate(
      Scenario        = fix_html_pipe(scenario_name),
      Discount_Factor = if_else(Year == 0, 1, 1 / (1 + discount_rate_in)^Year)
    )

  # Force a consistent set of columns across AV and AgOnly
  # (AgOnly doesn't have ITC_Rem, but AV does)
  required_cols <- c(
    "Scenario","Year",
    "Net_CF","PV_CF","Cum_NPV","Discount_Factor",
    "Tax","Taxable_Income","NOL_End","ITC_Rem"
  )

  # Add any missing columns as NA so bind_rows() stays clean
  missing <- setdiff(required_cols, names(df2))
  if (length(missing) > 0) {
    df2[missing] <- NA_real_
  }

  # Reorder so required cols come first, then anything else
  df2 %>% select(all_of(required_cols), setdiff(names(df2), required_cols))
}

## ---- Build tables (base policy + reference) ---------------------------
av_TGC <- av_table_policy(
  lam_override     = lam_base_TGC,
  rotation         = rot_TGC,
  policy           = base_policy_use,
  site             = site_for_plots,
  discount_rate_in = discount_rate
)

av_BGC <- av_table_policy(
  lam_override     = lam_base_BGC,
  rotation         = rot_BGC,
  policy           = base_policy_use,
  site             = site_for_plots,
  discount_rate_in = discount_rate
)

ag_TGC <- agonly_table(rot_TGC, policy_name = agonly_ref_policy, discount_rate_in = discount_rate)
ag_BGC <- agonly_table(rot_BGC, policy_name = agonly_ref_policy, discount_rate_in = discount_rate)

cf_TGC <- bind_rows(
  make_cashflow_table(av_TGC, paste0("AV | ", base_policy_use, " | TGC"), discount_rate),
  make_cashflow_table(ag_TGC, paste0("AgOnly | ", agonly_ref_policy, " | TGC"), discount_rate)
) %>% arrange(Scenario, Year)

cf_BGC <- bind_rows(
  make_cashflow_table(av_BGC, paste0("AV | ", base_policy_use, " | BGC"), discount_rate),
  make_cashflow_table(ag_BGC, paste0("AgOnly | ", agonly_ref_policy, " | BGC"), discount_rate)
) %>% arrange(Scenario, Year)

## ---- Print nicely (HTML) ----------------------------------------------
cf_TGC %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = 2,
               caption = "Year-by-year cash flow table: Tomato–Garbanzo–Corn (AV vs AgOnly)") %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped","condensed","bordered"),
                            full_width = FALSE, font_size = 10) %>%
  kableExtra::column_spec(1, bold = TRUE, width = "4.5cm")

cf_BGC %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = 2,
               caption = "Year-by-year cash flow table: BellPepper–Garbanzo–Corn (AV vs AgOnly)") %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped","condensed","bordered"),
                            full_width = FALSE, font_size = 10) %>%
  kableExtra::column_spec(1, bold = TRUE, width = "4.5cm")

## ---- Export to Excel (2 sheets) ---------------------------------------
out_file <- "cashflow_tables_AV_vs_AgOnly.xlsx"

wb <- createWorkbook()
addWorksheet(wb, "TGC_cashflow")
writeDataTable(wb, "TGC_cashflow", cf_TGC, tableStyle = "TableStyleMedium9")

addWorksheet(wb, "BGC_cashflow")
writeDataTable(wb, "BGC_cashflow", cf_BGC, tableStyle = "TableStyleMedium9")

# Optional: number formats
money_cols <- c("Net_CF","PV_CF","Cum_NPV","Tax","Taxable_Income","NOL_End","ITC_Rem")
df_cols    <- c("Discount_Factor")

money_style <- createStyle(numFmt = "#,##0.00")
df_style    <- createStyle(numFmt = "0.0000")

for (sheet in c("TGC_cashflow","BGC_cashflow")) {
  dat <- if (sheet == "TGC_cashflow") cf_TGC else cf_BGC

  for (cn in intersect(money_cols, names(dat))) {
    col_idx <- match(cn, names(dat))
    addStyle(wb, sheet, money_style, cols = col_idx, rows = 2:(nrow(dat)+1), gridExpand = TRUE, stack = TRUE)
  }
  for (cn in intersect(df_cols, names(dat))) {
    col_idx <- match(cn, names(dat))
    addStyle(wb, sheet, df_style, cols = col_idx, rows = 2:(nrow(dat)+1), gridExpand = TRUE, stack = TRUE)
  }
}

saveWorkbook(wb, out_file, overwrite = TRUE)

# Print the filename so you can see it in the knitted output/log
out_file
```

```{r,fig.width=16, fig.height= 9.1}
# Good practice: compute per-facet tile width so it’s consistent

  group_by(Rotation, Param_short) %>%
```

```{r,fig.width=17, fig.height=8.5}
## ---- 12) Cartesian sensitivity (Electricity price × PV CapEx × Policy) -
grid_P <- seq(0.02, 0.11, length.out = 25)
grid_C <- seq(1000, 3000, length.out = 25)

cartesian_run <- function(rot_name, rot_tbl, lam_baseline) {
  expand_grid(
    Rotation    = rot_name,
    Policy      = policy_tbl$Policy,
    P_elec      = grid_P,
    capex_per_kw = grid_C
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      NPV = pmap_dbl(list(Policy, P_elec, capex_per_kw), function(pol, pe, ck) {
        av_total_with_overrides(
          rotation_tbl = rot_tbl,
          lam_value    = lam_baseline,
          policy       = pol,
          overrides    = list(P_elec = pe, capex_per_kw = ck)
        )
      })
    )
}

cart_df <- bind_rows(
  cartesian_run("Tomato–Garbanzo–Corn",     rot_TGC, lam_base_TGC),
  cartesian_run("BellPepper–Garbanzo–Corn", rot_BGC, lam_base_BGC)
) %>%
  left_join(agonly_cf, by = "Rotation") %>%
  mutate(Delta_vs_AgOnly = NPV - AgOnly_NPV)
```

```{r,fig.width=17, fig.height=8.5}
  scale_y_continuous(labels = dollar_format(prefix="$")) +
labs(
  title = "Cartesian Sensitivity (NPV): Electricity price × PV CapEx × Tax Policy",
  subtitle = paste0(
    "Black contour = break-even where AV NPV equals AgOnly NPV (AV − AgOnly = 0) | discount rate = ",
    percent(discount_rate, accuracy = 0.1)
  ),
  x = "PV CapEx ($/kW-AC)",
  y = "Electricity price ($/kWh)"
) +
theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
theme(
  panel.grid = element_blank(),
  strip.text = element_text(face="bold", size=9),
  axis.text.x = element_text(angle=30, hjust=1)
)

print(p_cart)
```

```{r,fig.width=17, fig.height=10}
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

# ---------------------------
# 1) Settings (fast + stable)
# ---------------------------
P_search   <- seq(0.02, 0.11, length.out = 11)   # electricity-price search grid
capex_grid <- seq(1000, 3000, length.out = 25)   # PV CapEx grid
disc_grid  <- c(0.03, 0.05)

# Stable facet order
rotation_levels <- c("BellPepper–Garbanzo–Corn", "Tomato–Garbanzo–Corn")
disc_levels <- c(0.03, 0.05)

# ---------------------------
# 2) AgOnly reference NPVs by Rotation × DiscountRate (precompute once)
# ---------------------------
agonly_cf_dr <- expand_grid(
  Rotation     = rotation_levels,
  DiscountRate = disc_grid
) %>%
  mutate(
    AgOnly_NPV = pmap_dbl(list(Rotation, DiscountRate), function(rot, dr) {
      rot_tbl <- if (rot == "Tomato–Garbanzo–Corn") rot_TGC else rot_BGC
      agonly_table(rot_tbl, policy_name = agonly_ref_policy, discount_rate_in = dr) %>%
        summarise(v = last(Cum_NPV)) %>% pull(v)
    })
  )

# ---------------------------
# 3) Delta helper (AV - AgOnly)
# ---------------------------
delta_one <- function(rot_name, rot_tbl, lam_baseline, pol, pe, ck, dr) {

  av_npv <- av_total_with_overrides(
    rotation_tbl = rot_tbl,
    lam_value    = lam_baseline,
    policy       = pol,
    overrides    = list(P_elec = pe, capex_per_kw = ck, discount_rate = dr)
  )

  ag_npv <- agonly_cf_dr %>%
    filter(Rotation == rot_name, DiscountRate == dr) %>%
    pull(AgOnly_NPV) %>% .[1]

  av_npv - ag_npv
}

# ---------------------------
# 4) Find break-even electricity price for ONE (policy, capex, dr)
#    Uses sign-change + linear interpolation
# ---------------------------
find_break_P <- function(rot_name, rot_tbl, lam_baseline, pol, ck, dr) {

  deltas <- map_dbl(P_search, ~ delta_one(rot_name, rot_tbl, lam_baseline, pol, .x, ck, dr))

  # If no crossing in this P range, return NA
  if (all(deltas > 0) || all(deltas < 0)) return(NA_real_)

  # first sign-change interval
  idx <- which(deltas[-1] * deltas[-length(deltas)] <= 0)[1]
  if (is.na(idx)) return(NA_real_)

  p1 <- P_search[idx];     p2 <- P_search[idx + 1]
  d1 <- deltas[idx];       d2 <- deltas[idx + 1]

  # Avoid divide-by-zero (rare)
  if (d2 == d1) return(NA_real_)

  # Linear interpolation for Δ = 0
  p1 + (0 - d1) * (p2 - p1) / (d2 - d1)
}

# ---------------------------
# 5) Build break-even curves (THIS CREATES break_df)
# ---------------------------
build_break_df <- function(rot_name, rot_tbl, lam_baseline) {
  expand_grid(
    Rotation     = rot_name,
    DiscountRate = disc_grid,
    Policy       = policy_tbl$Policy,
    capex_per_kw = capex_grid
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      P_elec = pmap_dbl(
        list(Policy, capex_per_kw, DiscountRate),
        ~ find_break_P(rot_name, rot_tbl, lam_baseline, ..1, ..2, ..3)
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(P_elec))
}

break_df <- bind_rows(
  build_break_df("Tomato–Garbanzo–Corn",     rot_TGC, lam_base_TGC),
  build_break_df("BellPepper–Garbanzo–Corn", rot_BGC, lam_base_BGC)
) %>%
  mutate(
    Rotation     = factor(Rotation, levels = rotation_levels),
    DiscountRate = factor(DiscountRate, levels = disc_levels),
    Policy       = factor(Policy, levels = policy_tbl$Policy)
  )

# 6) Legend order: force sequential P1 -> P7
# ---------------------------
policy_code <- c(
  "Bonus 100% (Y1 only, NO MACRS)" = "P1",
  "MACRS"                         = "P2",
  "Bonus 100%+NOL"                = "P3",
  "MACRS+NOL"                     = "P4",
  "MACRS+ITC"                     = "P5",
  "MACRS+NOL+ITC"                 = "P6",
  "MACRS+NOL+ITC sold Y1"         = "P7"
)

# Desired order in legend (P1..P7)
policy_order <- names(policy_code)

# Apply that order to the data (THIS controls legend order)
break_df <- break_df %>%
  mutate(Policy = factor(as.character(Policy), levels = policy_order))

# Labels in legend: "P1 = ...", etc.
policy_labs_full <- setNames(
  paste0(policy_code[policy_order], " = ", policy_order),
  policy_order
)

# Colors: keep stable (7 colors) in the same order
policy_colors <- setNames(scales::hue_pal()(length(policy_order)), policy_order)

# ---------------------------
# 7) High-quality plot (legend sequential)
# ---------------------------
p_break <- ggplot(break_df, aes(x = capex_per_kw, y = P_elec, color = Policy, group = Policy)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.15, lineend = "round") +
  facet_grid(
    DiscountRate ~ Rotation,
    labeller = labeller(
      DiscountRate = function(x) paste0(percent(as.numeric(as.character(x)), accuracy = 0.1), " discount rate")
    )
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = policy_colors,
    breaks = policy_order,          # <-- forces P1..P7 order in legend
    labels = policy_labs_full,
    name   = "Tax policy"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = dollar, breaks = pretty_breaks(5)) +
  scale_y_continuous(
  limits = c(0.02, NA),   # start at 0.02, let ggplot choose the top
  labels = dollar_format(prefix = "$"),
  breaks = seq(0.02, 0.12, by = 0.02)
) +
  labs(
    title = "Break-even curves by tax policy, PV CapEx, and electricity price",
    subtitle = "Each curve shows where AV NPV = AgOnly NPV (Δ = 0). Panels show 3% and 5% discount rates.",
    x = "PV CapEx ($/kW-AC)",
    y = "Electricity price ($/kWh)"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8),

    # OPTION A: legend on bottom but ordered left-to-right P1..P7
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "horizontal",
    legend.key.width = unit(1.6, "cm"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 10),

    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 25, hjust = 1)
  )

print(p_break)
```


```{r,fig.width=17, fig.height=10}
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

# ---------------------------
# 1) Settings
# ---------------------------
P_search <- seq(0.02, 0.11, by = 0.002)
disc_grid <- c(0.03, 0.05)
disc_levels <- c(0.03, 0.05)

rotation_levels <- c("BellPepper–Garbanzo–Corn", "Tomato–Garbanzo–Corn")
capex_fixed <- 1678

# ---------------------------
# 2) AgOnly reference NPVs by Rotation × DiscountRate
# ---------------------------
agonly_cf_dr <- expand_grid(
  Rotation     = rotation_levels,
  DiscountRate = disc_grid
) %>%
  mutate(
    AgOnly_NPV = pmap_dbl(list(Rotation, DiscountRate), function(rot, dr) {
      rot_tbl <- if (rot == "Tomato–Garbanzo–Corn") rot_TGC else rot_BGC

      agonly_table(
        rotation = rot_tbl,
        policy_name = agonly_ref_policy,
        discount_rate_in = dr
      ) %>%
        summarise(v = last(Cum_NPV)) %>%
        pull(v)
    })
  )

# ---------------------------
# 3) Helper: AV NPV and Delta NPV
# ---------------------------
delta_one <- function(rot_name, rot_tbl, lam_baseline, pol, pe, ck, dr) {

  av_npv <- av_total_with_overrides(
    rotation_tbl = rot_tbl,
    lam_value    = lam_baseline,
    policy       = pol,
    overrides    = list(
      P_elec        = pe,
      capex_per_kw  = ck,
      discount_rate = dr
    )
  )

  ag_npv <- agonly_cf_dr %>%
    filter(Rotation == rot_name, DiscountRate == dr) %>%
    pull(AgOnly_NPV) %>%
    .[1]

  tibble(
    AV_NPV    = av_npv,
    AgOnly_NPV = ag_npv,
    Delta_NPV = av_npv - ag_npv
  )
}

# ---------------------------
# 4) Build data
# ---------------------------
build_elec_delta_df <- function(rot_name, rot_tbl, lam_baseline) {

  expand_grid(
    Rotation     = rot_name,
    DiscountRate = disc_grid,
    Policy       = policy_tbl$Policy,
    P_elec       = P_search
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      capex_per_kw = capex_fixed
    ) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      tmp = list(delta_one(rot_name, rot_tbl, lam_baseline, Policy, P_elec, capex_fixed, DiscountRate)),
      AV_NPV     = tmp$AV_NPV,
      AgOnly_NPV = tmp$AgOnly_NPV,
      Delta_NPV  = tmp$Delta_NPV
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(-tmp)
}

elec_delta_df <- bind_rows(
  build_elec_delta_df("Tomato–Garbanzo–Corn",     rot_TGC, lam_base_TGC),
  build_elec_delta_df("BellPepper–Garbanzo–Corn", rot_BGC, lam_base_BGC)
) %>%
  mutate(
    Rotation     = factor(Rotation, levels = rotation_levels),
    DiscountRate = factor(DiscountRate, levels = disc_levels)
  )

# ---------------------------
# 5) Legend order
# ---------------------------
policy_code <- c(
  "Bonus 100% (Y1 only, NO MACRS)" = "P1",
  "MACRS"                          = "P2",
  "Bonus 100%+NOL"                 = "P3",
  "MACRS+NOL"                      = "P4",
  "MACRS+ITC"                      = "P5",
  "MACRS+NOL+ITC"                  = "P6",
  "MACRS+NOL+ITC sold Y1"          = "P7"
)

policy_order <- names(policy_code)

elec_delta_df <- elec_delta_df %>%
  mutate(Policy = factor(as.character(Policy), levels = policy_order))

policy_labs_full <- setNames(
  paste0(policy_code[policy_order], " = ", policy_order),
  policy_order
)

policy_colors <- setNames(scales::hue_pal()(length(policy_order)), policy_order)

# ---------------------------
# 6) Plot TRUE break-even
# ---------------------------
p_break_even <- ggplot(
  elec_delta_df,
  aes(x = P_elec, y = Delta_NPV, color = Policy, group = Policy)
) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.7, color = "black") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.15, lineend = "round") +
  facet_grid(
    DiscountRate ~ Rotation,
    labeller = labeller(
      DiscountRate = function(x) {
        paste0(percent(as.numeric(as.character(x)), accuracy = 0.1), " discount rate")
      }
    )
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = policy_colors,
    breaks = policy_order,
    labels = policy_labs_full,
    name   = "Tax policy"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = dollar_format(prefix = "$", suffix = "/kWh"),
    breaks = seq(0.02, 0.11, by = 0.02)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = dollar_format(scale = 1e-6, suffix = "M")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Electricity-price sensitivity of AV profitability relative to AgOnly",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Y-axis shows ΔNPV = NPV(AV) − NPV(AgOnly); PV CapEx fixed at ",
      dollar(capex_fixed), "/kW-AC. ",
      "Break-even occurs where ΔNPV = 0."
    ),
    x = "Electricity price ($/kWh)",
    y = expression(Delta*"NPV = NPV"[AV] - NPV[AgOnly])
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title   = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.text   = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "horizontal",
    legend.key.width = unit(1.6, "cm"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 25, hjust = 1)
  )

print(p_break_even)
```
